This career suits people who work well with their hands, prefer moving to sitting, adapt quickly, and communicate clearly with owners, property managers, and tenants.

General Maintenance And Repair Workers maintain and repair common building and facility problems. Their work spans plumbing, electricity, lighting, doors, locks, walls, floors, and simple equipment. The role requires broad hands-on ability and quick judgment on site.

paragraphs: A typical day revolves around receiving jobs, traveling to sites, and completing repairs. Workers handle urgent power and water problems first, then repair locks and replace lights. They photograph completed work, update orders, inspect facilities, count parts, consult manuals or senior technicians, and close same-day faults before leaving.
